keys:
The goal of the game is to survive and destroy the enemy base.

The game is divided in 5 ages. To move to the next age, you need
Xp points. To gain these points, you have to kill enemy units.

You also gain Xp points when one of your units is killed. You can
also build defences. Finding the balance between defence and
offence is the key.

You will also be able to use a special attack. This attack will need
time to be available again after you use it. Each age have its own
special attack.

You cannot repair your base, but it will gain health points
everytime you evolve to the next age. Protect your base at all cost!

zh_CN__简体中文:
游戏目标是存活下来并摧毁敌方基地。

游戏分为 5 个时代。要进入下一个时代，你需要
经验值。消灭敌方部队可以获得经验值。

己方部队被消灭时，你也会获得经验值。你还可以
建造防御设施。攻守平衡是取胜的关键。

你还可以使用特殊攻击。使用后需要等待一段时间才能再次使用。
每个时代都有自己的特殊攻击。

基地无法维修，但每次进化到下一个时代时都会获得生命值。
不惜一切代价保护你的基地！

keys:
Oh boy there is a lot of people to give credit too.

Lets start off with the obvious, louissi. Even though there was legal trouble between him and maxgames, to me he will always be the owner of age of war. I wanted this game to be as close to the original, while making some QoL changes.

I would also like to thank my friends and family for always supporting me through rough times and giving me unconditional love.
I used a lot of tutorials on YouTube to put this together. As way of thanking those creators this game is free and open source. Check it out on Github!

Finally I would like to thank you, the player. Thank you for your time and I hope this was a nice nostalgia trip for you.

- Alex Piotrowski
zh_CN__简体中文:
制作这款游戏要感谢许多人。

先从最重要的人说起：louissi。虽然他与 maxgames 之间曾有法律纠纷，但在我心中，他永远是《Age of War》的创作者。我希望这款游戏尽可能接近原作，同时加入一些提升体验的改动。

还要感谢我的朋友和家人，在困难时期一直支持我，给予我无条件的爱。
我参考了 YouTube 上的大量教程完成了这款游戏。为了感谢这些创作者，本游戏免费且开源，欢迎在 Github 上查看！

最后感谢你——玩家。谢谢你愿意花时间游玩，希望这次旅程能带给你美好的怀旧体验。

- Alex Piotrowski
